# Dynamic host country names for Nova Elysia & the Twin-Capital Imperium Bicephalum.
OE_NOVA_ELYSIA = {
	country_trigger = {
		OR = {
			has_variable = oe_ely_is_elysia
			has_variable = oe_ely_is_nova_elysia
		}
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_elr_is_bicephalum }
	}

		continent = continent:america
	}
	location_trigger = {
	}
}
